recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（影像標註低倍，但實際放大倍率較高）中造血區由單形性、核深染而形狀不規則的小到中型細胞成片占據，細胞質少，殘存的嗜酸性顆粒球與紅系細胞零散分布於脂肪空泡間。
features: Interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate of small to medium-sized immature cells between fat spaces
High N:C ratio with irregular, focally convoluted hyperchromatic nuclei
Scant cytoplasm and fine chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Residual eosinophilic granulocytic precursors and erythroid cells scattered in the periphery
Fat spaces retained; overall cellularity cannot be fully judged from this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (labeled low power, although the field is at intermediate magnification) shows a hematopoietic area in which normal elements are largely replaced by a monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized immature cells with high N:C ratio, irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Residual eosinophilic granulocyte precursors and erythroid cells are scattered at the edges, and fat spaces are retained. Megakaryocytes are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by lymphoblastic leukemia, supported by immunophenotyping as T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mature T-cell lymphomas are TdT/CD34/CD1a negative with more pleomorphic nuclei and often associated fibrosis; immunohistochemistry is required.
Histology is identical; PAX5/CD79a versus CD3 immunostains separate lineage.
Aplastic marrow is markedly hypocellular with small mature lymphocytes and plasma cells, not sheets of immature blasts.
